column1: # Hand fixes for cards the automatic checks get wrong. action: keep or drop. Keep this list short;
# fix the rule instead when a pattern repeats. A keep also overrides the built-landmark exclusion words (landmarks.py).

column3: Montreal Forum: closed as an arena in 1996, the building still stands (Wikipedia lists it as demolished)
CalgaryNEXT: cancelled proposal; its Wikidata item now links to the Scotia Place article
Senate of Canada Building: the former Ottawa Union Station, so Wikidata also calls it a railway station
Casino du Lac-Leamy: a landmark casino; Wikidata also lists its heliport
2 World Trade Center: only the foundation is built; Wikidata calls it a skyscraper
Grand Central Terminal: a landmark building; Wikidata calls it a railway station
National Gallery of Art: Wikidata calls it a national gallery and a nonprofit organization
